context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly implements provider-level configuration with environment variable fallback and wires provider data to resources.

checklist.name: Provider schema attributes
checklist.description: Provider schema has endpoint (Optional String) and api_key (Optional Sensitive String) attributes with Description strings

checklist.name: Config.Get with diagnostics
checklist.description: Configure method reads config with req.Config.Get and checks resp.Diagnostics.HasError() with early return

checklist.name: Endpoint env var fallback
checklist.description: If endpoint is null or unknown in config, the code reads the EXAMPLE_ENDPOINT environment variable as a fallback using os.Getenv or similar

checklist.name: API key env var fallback
checklist.description: If api_key is null or unknown in config, the code reads the EXAMPLE_API_KEY environment variable as a fallback

checklist.name: Missing endpoint error diagnostic
checklist.description: If endpoint is still empty after env var fallback, an error diagnostic is added to resp.Diagnostics with a meaningful summary and detail

checklist.name: Provider data passed via response
checklist.description: Configure method sets resp.DataSourceData and resp.ResourceData so resources and data sources can access the configured client or config

checklist.name: Resource Configure method
checklist.description: example_resource has a Configure method that retrieves provider data from req.ProviderData, handles nil (early return), and type-asserts with error diagnostic on mismatch

checklist.name: Acceptance test
checklist.description: An acceptance test exists that configures the provider (via env vars or HCL) and runs at least one TestStep with a basic apply. Uses ProtoV6ProviderFactories
